lens: Prospective applicant — factual comprehension (simulated AI lens)
reason: The reviewed applicant journey has a coherent factual foundation: all-major eligibility, no consulting prerequisite, preparation materials, evaluation traits and the distinction between open mixers and evaluated conversations. The source separates account saves, temporary browser recovery and submission; explicit comparisons explain which copy will replace the other. Supplied synthetic browser tests exercise both recovery choices, interrupted submission and revision conflicts, and the local two-session log demonstrates its specific initial-save race. Dashboard source provides bookings, offer actions and explicit schedule-outage guidance. Materials and review copy accurately disclose original-resume access rather than promising anonymous PDFs. Desktop/mobile hero captures show legible hierarchy and a clear student entry within the established Precision Instrument identity. However, public recruitment failure can be presented as unpublished events. More broadly, this is source, supplied captures and local fixture evidence: it does not establish that students understand these distinctions or complete the connected journey successfully. I cannot give unqualified world-class agreement or establish release readiness from this package.

findings.evidence: fetchPublicRecruitment destructures only data from public_recruitment and returns {cycle:null} when data is absent. Join defaults missing events to [] and renders “The Board has not published events for this cycle yet.” Its inactive action leads to recruitment updates. A returned RPC error therefore shares the successful-empty content path.
findings.userImpact: During a recruitment-service failure, a student can infer that dates have not been published and choose to wait for announcements even if recruitment is actually open. The page cannot substantiate that factual assertion from a failed lookup.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve a distinct unavailable result, show a temporary lookup-failure message with retry/contact guidance, and retain a direct application/status entry. Reserve unpublished-event wording for a successful empty response; cover failure versus empty responses locally.

notVerified: No staging or hosted end-to-end evidence exists for Clerk identity, session expiry, actual Supabase RPC/RLS, storage uploads or email receipt delivery. Synthetic application responses and the race log do not prove these integrations.
No observed student study establishes comprehension of saved versus submitted, safe copy selection, eligibility or next-step discovery; this seat is an AI source review, not human usability evidence.
No supplied applicant-form or authenticated dashboard captures establish private-screen visual craft with real data; inspected visual evidence is limited to the public desktop/mobile hero.
Physical devices, Safari, Firefox, assistive technology, live cycle dates, Board privacy-policy resolution and operational rollout of revision migrations remain unverified in this review.
